notes: Fixes slow firearm image paint by allowing versioned WebP derivatives to remain in the private browser cache instead of forcing revalidation on every request.
Adds a stable media revision query key so changed images automatically receive a fresh URL while unchanged thumbnails remain cacheable.
Loads firearm collection thumbnails eagerly so visible cards request their 320px derivatives immediately instead of waiting on lazy-load scheduling.
Keeps unversioned media on a short private cache window and preserves authentication requirements.
